column1: # Stage S11a, agent J2d — the Enfusion MCP tooling leaves xtask and developer_tools. xtask's mcp
# command group and developer_tools' server entrypoint resolution become the enfusion_mcp crate
# (the command line, the client, the daemon control, the selftest, the Workbench calls and logs);
# the tokio broker behind the `mcpd` binary becomes the enfusion_mcp_broker crate. The crate
# roots, the broker's split and the xtask match arm are written by hand. Paths name the tree
# enfusion_mcp: the mcp command group; its module root becomes the crate root
# enfusion_mcp_broker: the broker and its offline stub
# the moved code names its own crate
